description:
[read-only] A brand's legal name, registered address, website, currency and timezone: what ad networks ask for when you open an ads account. `hasTaxId` says whether a tax id is on file; the tax id itself is never returned. Use an `id` from list_brands.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/brands/{id}/business-details.)

id.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. A brand-bound key may only name its own brand (another brand → 403).

name: brand_business_details_get
title: Get a brand's business details
